on_complete.text: Des can see you tomorrow. Lock-up, same time. Don't make a thing of it.

cards.label: Shoreditch — the lock-up
cards.text: Archie has the shutter half down and a laptop open on an upturned crate. He looks up when you come in and does not say well done.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Rent's paid. Good. Next Monday's already in the calendar, same sum, so don't get comfortable."
He turns the laptop round. The Ticker, a column of grey headlines, with one of them smeared by a thumbprint.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Emotion calc. Four buyers rang me this morning, all after the same stock, none of them wanting to say why." He shuts the lid. "Buyers are twitchy."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Keep an eye on the Ticker. It'll tell you what's moving in the calc world before anyone texts you about it. Usually."
He's already looking at his phone. "I'll text you about someone. Don't make a thing of it."
